newsitem.title: USA: PMR CFO knows no reason for stock drop.
newsitem.headline: PMR CFO knows no reason for stock drop.

text.p: PMR Corp's chief financial officer said he knew of no reason for the sharp drop in the company's stock, other than the fact that its illiquidity made it vulnerable to large swings.

"The only way I can explanin it is that we have a very limited number of market makers now which leads to increased volatility when there is a significant buy or sell," chief financial officer Mark Clein told Reuters.
"There is absolutely nothing with respect to the company's operations that we know about, (which would affect the stock price), Clein added.
PRM manages outpatient psychiatric programs and provides outpatient substance abuse treatment.
